tool_input.command:
rm -rf /tmp/t5manual && mkdir -p /tmp/t5manual
npm run --silent migrate -- 2>&1 | tail -5
DATABASE_PATH=/tmp/t5manual/db.sqlite npm run --silent migrate
DATABASE_PATH=/tmp/t5manual/db.sqlite PORT=3999 node dist/main.js &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 1
echo "--- headers for unknown slug ---"
curl -sD - -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3999/nope99
echo "--- body for /links/nope99 ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3999/links/nope99
echo
kill -TERM $SERVER_PID
wait $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null

result: T5 is done — no code changes were required. T4's implementation already threw `NotFoundException` on unknown slugs in both `LinksService.findBySlug` and `LinksService.redirect`, which satisfied all of T5's acceptance criteria (clean 404s on both routes, no `Location` header, JSON body with `message`, no DB rows created). I verified this by running T5's full verify command (exit 0), the unit suite (1/1 passing), and manual curl checks against a locally booted instance. Wrote `loop/proposal.json` with `outcome: "done"` and an empty `files` list since nothing changed.
